<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref, toRef, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { promptInputKey, type PromptStatus } from "./context"

/**
 * The composer: a growing textarea over a toolbar. Enter sends and
 * Shift+Enter breaks a line, or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends with `submit-on="mod-enter"`.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** v-model. Leave it unbound to let the field keep its own text. */
    modelValue?: string
    defaultValue?: string
    status?: PromptStatus
    submitOn?: "enter" | "mod-enter"
    disabled?: boolean
    /** Listening to `@stop` turns the send button into a stop button while busy. */
    onStop?: () => void
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { modelValue: undefined, defaultValue: "", status: "ready", submitOn: "enter", disabled: undefined, onStop: undefined }
)

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: string]
  /** Called with the trimmed text. The field clears itself after. */
  submit: [value: string]
}>()

const uncontrolled = ref(props.defaultValue)
const value = computed(() => props.modelValue ?? uncontrolled.value)

function setValue(next: string) {
  if (props.modelValue === undefined) uncontrolled.value = next
  emit("update:modelValue", next)
}

function submit() {
  const text = value.value.trim()
  if (!text || props.disabled || props.status === "submitted" || props.status === "streaming") return
  emit("submit", text)
  setValue("")
}

provide(promptInputKey, {
  value,
  setValue,
  submit,
  status: toRef(props, "status"),
  onStop: toRef(props, "onStop"),
  submitOn: toRef(props, "submitOn"),
  disabled: toRef(props, "disabled"),
})
</script>

<template>
  <form
    data-slot="prompt-input"
    :data-status="status"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex w-full flex-col gap-1 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-2 transition-colors',
        'focus-within:border-ring focus-within:ring-3 focus-within:ring-ring/30',
        props.class,
      )
    "
    @submit.prevent="submit"
  >
    <slot />
  </form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { ArrowUp, Square } from "@lucide/vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button, type ButtonVariantProps } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { usePromptInput } from "./context"

/** Sends while ready, stops while streaming. */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    variant?: ButtonVariantProps["variant"]
    size?: ButtonVariantProps["size"]
    sendLabel?: string
    stopLabel?: string
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { size: "icon", sendLabel: "Send", stopLabel: "Stop" }
)

const { value, status, onStop, disabled } = usePromptInput()
const busy = computed(() => status.value === "submitted" || status.value === "streaming")
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    v-if="busy && onStop"
    type="button"
    :variant="variant"
    :size="size"
    :aria-label="stopLabel"
    :class="cn('ms-auto', props.class)"
    @click="onStop?.()"
  >
    <Square class="size-3 fill-current" />
  </Button>
  <Button
    v-else
    type="submit"
    :variant="variant"
    :size="size"
    :aria-label="sendLabel"
    :loading="status === 'submitted'"
    :disabled="disabled || (busy && status !== 'submitted') || value.trim() === ''"
    :class="cn('ms-auto', props.class)"
  >
    <ArrowUp />
  </Button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { usePromptInput } from "./context"

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    placeholder?: string
    /** Height cap before the field scrolls. */
    maxRows?: number
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { placeholder: "Ask anything…", maxRows: 8 }
)

const emit = defineEmits<{ keydown: [event: KeyboardEvent] }>()

const { value, setValue, submit, submitOn, disabled } = usePromptInput()

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  // Your @keydown runs first and can preventDefault() to keep Enter.
  emit("keydown", event)
  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.key !== "Enter" || event.isComposing) return
  const mod = event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey
  const send = submitOn.value === "enter" ? !event.shiftKey : mod
  if (send) {
    event.preventDefault()
    submit()
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <textarea
    data-slot="prompt-input-textarea"
    rows="1"
    :value="value"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :placeholder="placeholder"
    :style="{ maxHeight: `calc(${maxRows} * 1.5rem + 1rem)` }"
    :class="
      cn(
        'field-sizing-content min-h-10 w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-2.5 py-2 text-sm leading-6 outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
        props.class,
      )
    "
    @input="setValue(($event.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).value)"
    @keydown="onKeydown"
  />
</template>
